statement: For MNIST, CelebA-HQ, and CIFAR-10, the alignment-minimizing transform W_min substantially and consistently improves five-seed average SW2 relative to natural alignment I under the exact iDDPM setup; the separate MNIST sample panel reports mode-collapse signs for W_max.
verification_requirement: Direct regenerated five-seed results for all three datasets with transformations W_min, I, and W_max, raw seed values, uncertainty, controls, and exact setup; or a valid assumption-satisfying counterexample.
route_policy: Run exactly three materially different verification-oriented routes. If confidence remains LOW, run a fourth route dedicated to falsification.
